newsitem.title: USA: TMM files with US SEC for $200 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: TMM files with US SEC for $200 mln notes.

text.p: Transportacion Maritima Mexicana SA de CV said Tuesday it filed a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in senior notes due 2006.
The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co and Bear Stearns & Co Inc, the filing said.

Net proceeds of about $74.6 million will be used to repay, at maturity, the outstanding principal amount of certain notes that were issued by one of its subsidiaries under the company's Euro Medium Term Note Program, the company disclosed in the filing.
The balance of the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including expenditures related to the expansion of the company's existing businesses and the acquisition of new businesses.
The company had announced in Mexico City on Monday it had planned to issue the notes and that it expects to place the notes with institutional investors in the United States.
The company is a maritime shipping company in Mexico and the leader among the world's carriers in serving Mexican ports.
